The '''speederboard''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] utilized by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advance Recon Force]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was known for providing quick, easy transportation, without utilizing the user's hands, which allowed them to use a variety of [[Blaster/Legends|weapons]]. This feature was incredibly useful on [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworlds]] such as [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="CW Toy" />

==History==
[[File:TCW_Rancor_Battalion_ARFs.png|thumb|left|200px|Rancor Battalion was known to use speederboards during the war.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched a full scale [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|invasion of Kamino]]. As a swarm of [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] began to invade the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], the [[Rancor Battalion/Legends|Rancor Battalion]] was deployed to fend of the Separatist invaders.<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> One of the troopers of this unit, an ARF trooper, utilized a speederboard with a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. His speederboard had [[Color|maroon]] and brown markings, with a black and white [[Republic crest/Legends|Galactic Roundel]] in the center.<ref name="CW Toy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The speederboard was created by [[Hasbro]] in [[2011]] for their [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] line of toys. Specifically, the ''ARF Trooper (Kamino)'' set. It came with both a speederboard, and an ARF trooper within [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]], equipped with two DC-15A [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]].<ref name="CW Toy" />
